quotes.text: I don't think it's Congress's job to say you can't have can't can't have this ... I do think there are guidelines that need to be in place ... [the developers] should not get a single tax break.

If a community doesn't want one, they shouldn't be forced to have one. Also, there should be no tax breaks for these things. I don't understand why some entity that is making and generating a ton of money needs a tax break.
